summary.file_check: Raw files written in the AncestryDNA, 23andMe, MyHeritage, FamilyTreeDNA, Living DNA and VCF layouts (including a GRCh38 VCF) are read back with every genotype exact.
summary.pca: Genomes reduced to about 92,858 SNPs (a genotyping chip's worth) land a median 0.90% of the map's width from where the same genomes land with all 1.15 million SNPs (356 placements of 178 held-out genomes).
summary.neanderthal: On 178 held-out genomes reduced to chip size, the 95% interval contained the estimate from all 1.15 million SNPs in 100% of cases.
summary.ancient_ancestry_accuracy: On simulated populations whose true proportions are known, the fitted proportions were within two standard errors of the truth for all 6 populations (largest deviation 0.515).
